subject: Project Coordinator, Civil Construction application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Etheredge Mintern team,

I'm applying for the Project Coordinator role in Kilsyth that I saw on SEEK.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, tracked procurement and materials, kept material records and wrote site and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues. In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD.

Your role covers subcontractor and supplier coordination, project documentation and progress tracking on road, drainage and earthworks jobs, which is the side of civil work I want to build on. I'm based in Melton VIC with a licence and my own transport, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't held a project coordinator title before, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: Etheredge Mintern has delivered road reconstruction, drainage, earthworks, car park and local government projects across Melbourne and Victoria for over 40 years.
letter.subject: Project Coordinator, Civil Construction, Kilsyth
paragraphs: I am applying for the Project Coordinator role in Kilsyth advertised on SEEK. Keeping subcontractors, suppliers, documentation and progress records in order across civil projects is the work I want to build my career on, and your road, drainage and earthworks pipeline is a good place to do it.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, passed on work priorities, tracked progress and kept the client up to date. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to keep work moving.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

I am based in Melton VIC with an Australian driver's licence, my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have not held a project coordinator title before, so I would start at junior level and learn your systems quickly.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
